dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi again! Do you want to join a club?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ əˈɡɛn! duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈdʒɔɪn ə ˈklʌb?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! But I'm busy. How often does the music club practice?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! bʌt aɪm ˈbɪzi. ˈhaʊ ˈɔːfən dʌz ðə ˈmjuːzɪk ˌklʌb ˈpræktɪs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Three times a week: on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz ə ˈwiːk: ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ, ˈwɛnzdeɪ ənd ˈsætərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, I work on the weekend. And the photo club?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈwɜːrk ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd. ənd ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌklʌb?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The photo club meets once a week, on Friday evening.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌklʌb ˈmiːts ˈwʌns ə ˈwiːk, ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great! And they take photos in the park twice a month.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ðeɪ ˈteɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrk ˈtwaɪs ə ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I want to join the photo club!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈdʒɔɪn ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌklʌb!
